about: The parent alert (lib/alert.mjs), configuration and never code. timeoutMs is how long a kid's reply waits for the family's account to take the alert before it goes on without saying a parent was told: 4 seconds since v0.8.0, because the family's account took 2.06 s to answer its first alert after a quiet spell on 2026-11-10, past the 2 seconds it had before. homeCheck is the one question asked of the safeguard model before any alert leaves (is the trouble at home?): which model, how long it may take, and how much of the sitting it reads; no answer in time means no alert. Who is alerted, what sets it off and that abuse never does are code and the founder's decisions of 2026-11-09, not settings. This file is inside the image, so a change here is a release.
